issues.on_page: Only Schedule 1 (budget and actual, unaudited; report p16 of 21) is in the trimmed PDF
issues.issue: Manifest flags no_statements_found. The 21-page audit almost certainly holds basic statements that the trimmer missed. The balance sheet and basic-statement lines can't be checked until the PDF is re-trimmed.

issues.on_page: (Budgetary Basis); Fund balances at beginning/end of year
issues.issue: Basis is assumed. Comparable Douglas County SID audits are GAAP; if this one is too, 1,042,807 / 879,213 belong in beginning_fund_balance / ending_fund_balance.
The amount matches the printed 'Fund balances at beginning of year', but it is marked computed even though it is printed as-is. Same for ending_cash 879,213.

issues.on_page: Collection fees on property taxes - County Treasurer (2,802)
issues.issue: Netting the fee against property tax is defensible because it is printed within revenues. It could also be treated as a treasurer-fee expense.

issues.on_page: Debt service - warrant principal and interest 5,251,448
